subject: Add horizontal line at the Maximum and Minimum point for Box plot

messages.author: 7430a89871427e77
messages.subject: Add horizontal line at the Maximum and Minimum point for Box plot
parts:
Hi there,

I am having trouble to add a horizontal line as an indicator for max and minimum value in a box plot with ggplot2. These lines are always exist when box plots are directly generated without using this package. I am wondering if there is a way to add it with ggplot2. Thank you very much in advance!

Samuel

messages.author: 8dd23dfee7198248
messages.subject: Re: Add horizontal line at the Maximum and Minimum point for Box plot
parts:
Hi Samuel, 

Take a look at geom_vline () and  geom_hline (), it might help you.
If you provide an example, more people would help you.

best
Nicolay
